claims.text: Role in ADHD: preschoolers: behavioral therapy first; meds if the response is inadequate or Sx are moderate–severe;
claims.quote: Preschool-aged children: Initial treatment is with behavioral therapy. Medications may be considered if the response to behavioral interventions is inadequate or if the symptoms are moderate-to-severe
School-aged children: Initial treatment is behavioral therapy in combination with medications.

claims.text: methylphenidate or amphetamine salts are the most widely used.
claims.quote: Stimulant preparations that include methylphenidate or amphetamine salts are most widely used.

claims.text: Common AEs: insomnia, HA, stomachache, appetite suppression, ↑HR and BP;
claims.quote: Common adverse effects of stimulant medications include Sleep disturbances (eg, insomnia) Headache Stomachache Appetite suppression Elevated heart rate and blood pressure

claims.text: height growth slows over 2 yrs of use, and adult height potential may be ↓ w chronic use.
claims.quote: Studies have shown growth in height slows over 2 years of stimulant medication use, and adult height potential may be diminished with chronic stimulant use

claims.text: CNS stimulant boxed warning (Ritalin): high potential for abuse and misuse → SUD incl addiction; misuse can cause OD and death.
claims.quote: Ritalin has a high potential for abuse and misuse, which can lead to the development of a substance use disorder, including addiction. Misuse and abuse of CNS stimulants, including Ritalin, can result in overdose and death
